identifying somebody from DNA: the analysis và use of DNA patterns from body tissues such as blood, saliva, hoặc semen in order to establish somebody's identity
enzyme that repairs DNA double helix: an enzyme that joins up a break in a single strand of DNA so that it reconstitutes the double strand in a DNA molecule
enzyme reproducing and repairing DNA: an enzyme that uses single-stranded DNA to reproduce và repair DNA
antiviral drug: a drug that inhibits formation of viral DNA
enzyme promoting DNA replication: a polymerase enzyme that causes the synthesis of an exact copying of a length of DNA
use of DNA as copying template: the process by which existing DNA is used as a template for the synthesis of new DNA strands in the cell nucleus
order of DNA base pairs: the relative order of base pairs in a fragment of DNA, a gene, a chromosome, hoặc an entire genome
discovering of DNA sequence: the process of determining the exact sequence of the bases along a section length of DNA
virus with genome containing DNA: a virus with a genome containing DNA
DNA-splitting enzyme: an enzyme that aids the breakdown of DNA into smaller molecules. Full form deoxyribonuclease
